content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

ambience.description: When true, generate a seamlessly loopable ambience tile (room tone, rain, drones, etc.). When false, generate a generic text-conditioned SFX of `duration` seconds.
ambience.title: Ambience

double_output.description: Only used when ambience=true: concatenate the loop with itself for a 2x-length output.
double_output.title: Double Output

duration.description: Duration of the generated audio in seconds. The minimum is 0.1s for ordinary sound effects and 1s when ambience=true.
duration.title: Duration

seed.description: Seed for generation. -1 or None for random.
seed.title: Seed

text_prompt.description: Text prompt for the generated audio.
text_prompt.title: Text Prompt

upload_audio_format.description: Audio format for the returned files.
upload_audio_format.title: Upload Audio Format

audio.description: Generated SFX audio from a text prompt.
audio.title: Audio
